source.landing_page: https://rasp2.zhanglab.net/download/ (RASP v2; track rotavirus/SHAPE-MaP_NAR_2022_Coria/RFS11_50mM_DMS.bw; Coria et al. 2022 NAR, doi:10.1093/nar/gkac738)

loader_options.buffer: 5 mM HEPES-Na pH 7.5, 100 mM NaCl (bicine pH 8.0 added to 200 mM before DMS)
loader_options.name: Rotavirus A RF segment 11 (NSP5)

mask_reason: No extra mask. Positions 1-5, 8-10, 311 and 608-667 have no value in the track and are already NaN (608-667 at the 3' end is presumably the RT/PCR primer-binding region; Supplementary Table S1 of the paper was not checked).

report_notes.construct: Bovine rotavirus A strain RF, genome segment 11 (NSP5/NSP6 mRNA), full-length in vitro T7 transcript (667 nt in the RASP reference). In vitro DMS-MaPseq, 0.5% (v/v) DMS ('50mM' in the RASP track name), no NSP2. Coria et al. 2022 NAR 50:10078.
report_notes.region: R = 6-55: the first 50 nt of the RNA that have data (same rule as the other datasets), 5'-anchored windows.
data_caveats: Conditions from the paper's Methods (not from the file): refolded 65 °C 5 min then slow cooling; probed at 37 °C for 1 min in 5 mM HEPES-Na pH 7.5, 0.5 mM MgCl2, 100 mM NaCl, ~200 mM bicine pH 8.0.
Track values are RASP's 'raw' DMS-MaPseq reactivities; normalisation does not matter for Spearman correlation.
Data come from RASP v2 (genome-coordinate bigWig); the sequence is taken from RASP's reference FASTA for segment RFS11.
limitations: Low Mg2+ (0.5 mM) differs from the 10 mM Mg2+ RMDB datasets; none of the models has a Mg2+ term.
A viral mRNA segment, not a cellular 5' UTR.
